correctness.evidence: Independent cyclic development verified 35 blocks and all 105 pairs for both systems; independent parallel-class enumeration gave 56/11; exact-cover resolution count 240/0; stabilizer counts 1344/4 with translations gave automorphism orders 20160/60; independent cyclic-generator census gave 36 systems split 18/18.

originality.evidence: Topalova 2016, DOI 10.13069/jacodesmath.47635, §3.2/Table 1 states exactly two cyclic STS(15) with automorphism orders 60 and 20160, only the latter resolvable, with two nonisomorphic resolutions of automorphism order 168. Thus the 240 labeled resolutions follow as 2*(20160/168).

value.evidence: After prior-art subtraction, only small finite bookkeeping counts and an explicit coordinate realization remain; bounded repair to those residual counts lacks a structural theorem, new regime, or meaningful algorithmic improvement.

checked_sources.title: S. Topalova, On the resolutions of cyclic Steiner triple systems with small parameters
checked_sources.finding: Two cyclic STS(15), automorphism orders 60/20160; only 20160 design resolvable; two nonisomorphic resolutions with autR 168.
